parameters.name: mortar_thickness
parameters.justification: Nacre-like organic/siloxane mortar between platelets (~20-50 nm).

parameters.name: shear_lag_factor
parameters.justification: beta^2 = 2*G_m*L^2/(E_p*t_p*t_m) = 2*5e7*(8e-6)^2/(1.5e11*4e-7*2e-8) = 5.33 on the platelet length normalised to 1.
